title: OneDrive synced folder
whyItMatters: OneDrive mirrors personal and work files onto the Mac. The local copies remain after sign-out and can include whole Desktop and Documents trees.
source: macOS File Provider sync roots under ~/Library/CloudStorage - https://www.macforensics.app/en/artifacts/cloud-storage-clients
notes: Newer macOS 12.3+ location (OneDrive-Personal, OneDrive-<Org>). Older ~/OneDrive installs are not matched. Placeholders are counted, never hydrated.

cleanup.exportFirst: Copy any file you need from the OneDrive folder in Finder to a drive you keep, since the local copies are removed.
cleanup.signOut: In the OneDrive menu bar icon open the settings and unlink this Mac, so the Microsoft account stops syncing here.
steps: Quit OneDrive from the menu bar icon so the folder is not in use.
Delete the OneDrive folder named in the plan, then empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Local copies are removed. Files stay in the Microsoft account, and a file that existed only here is gone.
cleanup.source: Microsoft Support, Turn off, disable, or uninstall OneDrive: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/turn-off-disable-or-uninstall-onedrive-f32a17ce-3336-40fe-9c38-6efb09f944b0
